git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-abandon-on-close/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-executor-throw/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(transport): answer frames in arrival order

A ping was answered synchronously while a list_sessions sent before it
waited on its store, so the pong overtook the list's answer on the wire.
The client only saw the answer first when both frames happened to land in
one read, which is why the acceptance suite passed on a fast machine and
went red on CI's loaded one: its helper collects frames until the pong.

Each non-turn answer now joins a per-socket tail, so one connection's
answers leave in the order its frames arrived - a list still never queues
behind a turn, which the lock alone serialises. Stated in the protocol
spec beside the off-lock rule, with the citations my new case shifted
repointed by name.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

Refs re-cinq/HALEngine#144
EOF
)" && git push origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -3
